name: pre-mortem
description: Pre-mortem analysis (Gary Klein). Imagine the project has already failed, then retrospectively identify why. Elicits 10-20 failure modes across categories (strategic, execution, market, technical, organizational, external), clusters and scores by impact-to-failure, proposes preventive actions per top cluster, and exports risks to risk-register / fmea / mitigation-strategy-planning. Mermaid diagrams with optional PNG export.
